changelog:
Playback speed is now picked from a list, fastest first, instead of stepping through the speeds one click at a time.
While zoomed in on live view, playback or an alert's clip or snapshot, drag to move around the picture.
The Registry's people and vehicle lists are more compact, and hovering a photo shows it larger.
Every page now opens scrolled to the top, instead of keeping where you'd scrolled on the last page.
AI detection no longer goes silent on a camera for hours after its stream reconnects.
